item.title: 1. Spec to layout: how far can agents get?
item.description:
GPT-Synopsys, NVIDIA's chip-design partners at SEMICON West, Rambus going company-wide with ChipAgents, a deep dive on Build-A-Chip Bench, and a verification corner on why a passing tool isn't proof of intent.

Sources:

  • OpenAI and Synopsys announce GPT-Synopsys (AnySilicon)
  • NVIDIA and semiconductor leaders advance AI across chip design and manufacturing (GlobeNewswire)
  • Chip Industry Week In Review, Oct 23 (Semiconductor Engineering)
  • ChipAgents expands Series A to $134 million (Unite.AI)
  • Socionext expands agentic AI to large-scale SoC physical design (Finviz)
  • Build-A-Chip Bench results (ChipAgents)
  • ChipAgents and NVIDIA put autonomous chip design to the test (SemiWiki)
  • A Survey on LLM-Integrated Hardware Design Verification (arXiv)

Researched and written by Claude; voiced with synthetic speech.
